author: DJI
description:
Air 3S supports the Advanced Pilot Assistance Systems (APAS). Additionally, as the first DJI drone to feature forward-facing LiDAR, Air 3S also features a downward infrared time-of-flight (ToF) sensor and six vision sensors to achieve nightscape omnidirectional obstacle sensing. 

Would you trust this in a forest at night? Drop a 🌑 if you’re brave enough!

🎥: Buziyouxunji
